images.title: Woods - Train Depot Building Map
images.description: Map showing the northwest building of the Woods train depot where Prapor's package can appear. The depot is accessed through the BTR Driver's taxi service.
images.objective_id: Locate and obtain Prapor's package on Woods

images.title: Woods - Package Building Exterior
images.description: Identify the northwest building at the train depot. Both possible package locations are inside this building.
images.objective_id: Locate and obtain Prapor's package on Woods

images.title: Package Spawn 1 - Under the Table
images.description: First possible package spawn: check underneath the table next to the bed inside the train depot building.
images.objective_id: Locate and obtain Prapor's package on Woods

images.title: Package Spawn 2 - Back Office Desk
images.description: Second possible package spawn: check the desk in the back office of the same building.
images.objective_id: Locate and obtain Prapor's package on Woods

images.title: Woods - Train Depot Exit Approach
images.description: Visual reference for reaching the western train, an alternative route for leaving the depot after retrieving the package.
images.objective_id: Survive and extract from the location

images.title: Woods - Route Along the Train
images.description: Follow the top of the western train when using this route. Stay near the center of the train; the surrounding ground is dangerous due to mines and sniper fire.
images.objective_id: Survive and extract from the location
